invalidBody: This link is not valid. Please scan the QR on the door.
unavailableTitle: Check-in is not available right now
unavailableBody: We could not load the check-in form. Check your internet and scan the QR on the door again in a minute.
welcomeBody: Takes about 2 minutes. No app or login needed.
readyId: A photo ID for each adult
privacy: Shared only with your host, for guest registration
fullName: Full name, as on your ID
errName: Enter your full name as it is on your ID.
errPhone: Enter a mobile number we can reach you on.
errCheckOut: Pick your check-out date (today or later).
idBody: Indian law requires your host to keep an ID copy for every adult guest.
errPhotoRead: We could not read this photo. Please take it again.
errPhotos: Add a photo for every adult ({count} missing).
photosPrivate: Photos are sent straight to your host and are never shown on this page again.
passportBody: Your host must register foreign guests with FRRO (Form C) within 24 hours of arrival.
noRules: Please follow the instructions your host gives you.
agree: I have read and agree to the house rules for everyone in my group
errAgree: Tick the box to agree to the house rules.
errRateLimited: Too many check-ins from this door in the last hour. Wait a few minutes and try again, or message your host.
errInvalid: Some details are not right. Go back and check them, then try again.
errServer: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a minute.
errNetwork: We could not reach the server. Check your internet and try again.
errUpload: {count, plural, one {# photo did not send.} other {# photos did not send.}}
errUploadRetry: Your details are saved. Check your internet and try again.
errUploadFatal: Your details are saved. Please show your ID at the door instead.
skipPhotos: Finish and show my ID at the door
photosSkippedNote: Some ID photos did not reach your host. Please show your original ID when you get the keys.
doneBody: Your host has your details. Enjoy Kochi!
next1: Our housekeeper meets you with the keys
next2: Show your original ID at the door
hostMessage: Hello, I have just checked in to {code} at Beehive Home. – {name}
